svg.title: npm install -g @urna/cli
svg.desc: urna, end to end: urna setup on an empty machine (scan, plan, the offline embedder payload, the python env, the doctor checks), then urna tui: open a corpus, ask it, read the cited answer, check the install, quit. Steps: 1 · npm install -g: the package and the release binary / 2 · the binary on PATH

g.text: 1 package has install scripts not yet covered by allowScripts:
Run `npm install -g --allow-scripts=@urna/cli` to allow these scripts once,
or `npm config set allow-scripts=@urna/cli --location=user` to allow them for all global installs.

text.tspan: npm install -g: the package and the release binary
